abstract: Prior research analyzes the economic effects of Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS)—such as Fairtrade, Organic, and GlobalGAP—but little is known about the stability of these effects over time. Using a nationally representative farm survey of Peru (2015–2019), this study analyzes whether VSS certification is associated with reduced inter‐annual price and yield volatility. Applying pooled OLS, matching, and internal instruments, we find that certification is associated with 27% lower price volatility and 17% lower yield volatility, particularly benefiting family farms, translating into an 81% reduction in their net farm revenue volatility. The results highlight VSS' potential to enhance revenue stability.
abstract_zh: 已有研究分析了自愿性可持续标准（VSS）——如公平贸易、有机认证和全球良好农业规范——的经济效应，但关于这些效应随时间稳定性的认知仍十分有限。本研究利用秘鲁全国代表性农户调查数据（2015-2019年），分析VSS认证是否与降低的年际价格波动和产量波动相关。通过混合OLS回归、匹配法和内部工具变量法，我们发现认证与价格波动降低27%、产量波动降低17%显著相关，其中家庭农场受益尤为突出，其净农场收入波动降幅达81%。研究结果凸显了VSS在增强收入稳定性方面的潜力。
title: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
title_zh: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动

abstract: Increased frequency of extreme weather events, particularly droughts, threatens grassland farming by destabilizing yields and farms' economic viability. We examine, theoretically and through numerical simulations, how sown plant diversity (natural insurance) influences the attractiveness of indemnity and drought index insurance (formal insurance) in grassland systems across Europe. Our analysis shows that higher sown diversity reduces farmers' willingness to pay for indemnity insurance, suggesting adverse selection. In contrast, drought index insurance remains equally attractive regardless of diversity. These effects hold across different insurance designs and risk preferences. Our findings offer valuable insights for farmers, insurers, and policymakers aiming to build resilient, sustainable agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 极端天气事件（尤其是干旱）频率的增加，通过破坏产量和农场的经济可行性，威胁着草地农业。我们通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究了欧洲草地系统中播种植物多样性（自然保险）如何影响赔偿保险和干旱指数保险（正式保险）的吸引力。分析表明，较高的播种多样性降低了农民对赔偿保险的支付意愿，这表明存在逆向选择。相比之下，无论多样性如何，干旱指数保险的吸引力保持不变。这些效应在不同的保险设计和风险偏好下均成立。我们的研究结果为农民、保险公司和政策制定者提供了宝贵见解，旨在构建具有韧性和可持续性的农业系统。
title: Coping With Production Risk: Effects of Sown Plant Diversity on the Attractiveness of Crop Insurance in Grasslands
title_zh: 应对生产风险：播种植物多样性对草地作物保险吸引力的影响
